Optimize the issue of echo in voice communication.
Add New Year fireworks.
Wishing everyone a Happy New Year filled with good luck and may all your wishes come true![previewyoutube=n3HcS9e34Zs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bug fixes and new tasks
notes.notes: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all users who reported bugs. Without your help, it would have been difficult for me to identify these issues. We have fixed the following: guild chat abnormalities, server-side exceptions preventing client connections, server-side voice chat memory leaks, equipment anomalies, the issue where only the team leader gained experience, and optimized the damage calculation formula. Additionally, we have added new main storyline guidance quests and bounty missions.
